messages.content: You can call create_event to add an appointment to the user's calendar.
Add a meeting with the marketing team tomorrow at 2 PM for one hour in the main conference room.

function.name: create_event
function.description: Create a new event on the user's calendar.

message.content:
<think>The user wants to schedule a meeting. Let me gather the details:
- Meeting with: marketing team
- Day: tomorrow
- Time: 2 PM
- Duration: 1 hour
- Location: main conference room

I need to convert "tomorrow" to an actual date. Today is Monday, January 20, 2025, so tomorrow is Tuesday, January 21, 2025. The meeting would start at 2 PM, which in 24-hour format is 14:00.

Let me create the event with these parameters:
- Title: "Meeting with marketing team" (or similar)
- Start: 2025-01-21T14:00:00
- Duration: 60 minutes (1 hour)
- Location: main conference room
</think>
